known.summary: shebangInterpreter takes the word right after `--` as the interpreter, but `env` still reads NAME=VALUE assignments after `--`, so `#!/usr/bin/env -S -- FORCE_COLOR=0 bun` yields `FORCE_COLOR=0` and the toolchain check rejects a valid Bun declaration.

The aliased-timeline test reads `issue.updatedAt` as the expected close time although its query never selects `updatedAt`, so it relies on the fake gh returning unselected issue fields and breaks under a faithful projection.
